reproduces: A Lever job posting: a JobPosting record in the page's JSON-LD, the per-ATS container, and an apply link that leads to the form on a DIFFERENT page. The Tier A case, and the one that shows a posting outranking form-shaped evidence.
reconstructed: Everything. The `[data-ui="job-post"]` container is quoted from the per-ATS marker list in design section 5. The apply link's text is the ordinary posting wording and is here because it makes the page score two points of Tier B evidence while carrying no form at all — which is the point: the JSON-LD record decides this page, not the count. The JSON-LD is declared as a SHAPE rather than written out and the harness builds the document, because the corpus guard rejects the at-sign every JSON-LD key begins with — and rightly: it is the same character an email address is caught by.
